atoms.1: A corneal abrasion is a superficial injury to the cornea.
atoms.2: The cornea is the clear layer on the front of the eye.
atoms.3: A corneal abrasion can be caused by trauma.
atoms.4: A corneal abrasion can be caused by foreign bodies.
atoms.5: A corneal abrasion can be caused by chemical exposure.
atoms.6: In most cases, a corneal abrasion does not typically cause discharge from the eye.

atoms.8: Some individuals may experience a mild amount of discharge due to the irritation of the cornea.
atoms.9: The discharge from a corneal abrasion is usually clear or watery in nature.

atoms.11: The discharge from a corneal abrasion may be accompanied by grittiness in the eye.

atoms.14: The presence of discharge in a corneal abrasion can be influenced by the individual's overall eye health.

atoms.17: If the discharge is green in color, it may indicate a more serious underlying condition that requires medical attention.

atoms.21: A corneal abrasion can increase the risk of infection.
